posts.name: sneha
posts.cooked:
I am writing to kindly seek clarification regarding the BPT-1 for this subject.
As per the academic calendar, BPT-1 for System Commands is scheduled to begin on 23rd May and end on 29th May. I would like to know if it is mandatory to attempt it on the very first day (23rd May), or if it would be possible for me to take it on a later date within the given window, such as 28th May.

posts.name: amit_kulkarni
posts.cooked: Yes, you can attempt the BPTs anytime within the stipulated dates. They are kind of programming assignments.

posts.name: Sarvesh Shivaji Ghodke
posts.cooked:
Is BPT Proctored like OPPE?
I am totally confused between OPPE, BPT & NPPE, need clarification regarding the differences between them.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Have you gone through the README.md file present in /opt/se2001/README.md? Because it clearly mentions what each assignment is.

BPT is not proctored, it is open for a week and you can attempt whenever you want.
NPPE is an old term, it simply means OPPE Mock. It is not graded.
OPPE is proctored and graded.
